test.create_query: CREATE TABLE ttl_delete_on_insert (ts DateTime, payload UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY payload TTL ts + INTERVAL 1 DAY SETTINGS non_replicated_deduplication_window = 0, parts_to_delay_insert = 50000, parts_to_throw_insert = 50000, auto_statistics_types = ''
test.query: INSERT INTO ttl_delete_on_insert SELECT toDateTime('2000-01-01 00:00:00'), number FROM numbers(1000000) SETTINGS insert_deduplicate = 0
